title: sandboxed execution with --verbose_failures is really noisy

labels.name: P3
labels.description: We're not considering working on this, but happy to review a PR. (No assignee)

body:
With --verbose_failures, all sandboxed spawn actions spew out a bunch of debugging information about the sandbox setup, even successful ones.

I like the extra information when one fails, but it can become hard to find in the deluge.

Trivial example:
BUILD:

```
genrule(
  name = 'test',
  outs = ['file.txt'],
  cmd = 'echo a > $@',
)
```
